issue.title: Please merge revision 4ec3db6 into dev channel

repository.name: sdk
repository.description: The Dart SDK, including the VM, JS and Wasm compilers, analysis, core libraries, and more.

issue.body:
Please cherry-pick 4ec3db6947cdbb554c395d4b98196293bf7de3bc in dev.  This fixes #23755 and https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/2798, so it's probably worth doing this merge before the next push to dev if we can.

Some background: the reorganization I did earlier of the SDK files (mainly `libraries.dart`) makes old versions of the analyzer package break. The patch makes us keep a copy in the generated sdk folder to avoid breaking users.

Eventually, we'll be able to remove this once the analyzer package releases a new version that can handle the new location of `libraries.dart` and users are upgraded to that newer analyzer.

body: I submitted the fix in master (https://github.com/dart-lang/sdk/commit/4ec3db6947cdbb554c395d4b98196293bf7de3bc), it should hopefully be available in the next dev release.
/cc @tbosch - reactivate dev build when this is fixed. @sigmundch or @kevmoo could you update this issue when the new dev build is available so we could reactivate the dev pipeline?
